description: Edit a LONG-FORM 16:9 talking-head video (YouTube) in the SCREENSHARE style: the video behaves like a live screen-share call. The camera is a panel that TRAVELS (never cuts) between full frame, a half-screen card beside a real interface, and a 300px corner card while a big UI does the demo. The screen shares are PLAYED for the creator — rebuilt UIs with a scripted cursor, typing and clicks, plus real captured websites — on a breathing dot-field ground in the creator's own colours. Measured layout mix (16% full camera / 39% half / 35% demo), a layout change every ~8s, captions locked in one place. Uses HyperFrames (HTML→MP4), all free. Invoke when the user drops a recording and asks to edit it with nextphase-screenshare / "the screenshare style", or asks to set up / re-theme this skill.
